facts.material: gold-plated base metal implements (assumed base metal) in a leather zip case
facts.function: personal grooming (tweezers, nail clippers, scissors, pen knife, shoe horn)
facts.form: retail set in fitted leather container

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8214 includes manicure or pedicure sets and instruments; 8214.20 sets; note 3 to chapter 82 treats sets of articles of 8214 etc.
GRI 3(b): the set's essential character is the manicure/pedicure implements; container (4202) follows the set under the 8214.20.60 'in leather containers' line

rejected_alternatives.reason: manicure sets in other containers; this case has a leather container
leather cases with contents: the container is specially fitted for the set; the implements give the essential character
pen knife alone; set classified as a whole

missing_facts: Assumed the implements are of base metal (plated with gold), not precious metal (chapter 71)
classification.rationale: A toilet set of grooming implements (tweezers, nail clippers, scissors) in a leather zip case is a manicure/pedicure set of heading 8214, and the provision for sets in leather containers is 8214.20.60. L82484 supports classifying manicure and pedicure sets under 8214.20; the leather container distinction is by the tariff text.
